== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Cirian is a four-star [[Titan]] who serves as a squad leader. A veteran of combat, he possesses the ability to generate protective barriers fueled by his own power and can utilize [[Wolf]] techniques to reinforce his strikes. He is also capable of traveling through Way{{!}}the Way instantaneously and has demonstrated the strength to repel lightning bolts from a planet. During a confrontation with Ozriel, Cirian displayed significant resilience and defiance, even while facing physical injury and the prospect of punishment. He maintains a long-standing acquaintance with [[Pariana]], a member of his squad, and holds personal connections to the world of [[Threshold]], where he has distant relatives living.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Cirian is a four-star [[Titan]] whose status is comprised of two stars as a [[Fox]] and one star as a [[Wolf]].}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|As a squad leader, Cirian identifies himself as Cirian of the [[Titans]]. He views the actions of Ozriel as pure evil.}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Cirian is a combatant who possesses a [[Presence]]. He utilizes both [[Fox]] techniques and [[Wolf]] techniques in battle.}}

== Threshold: Stories from Cradle ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Cirian of the [[Titans]] is a four-star combatant who utilizes both [[Fox]] and [[Wolf]] techniques, possessing a rank comprised of two stars as a [[Fox]] and one star as a [[Wolf]]. As a squad leader with a [[Presence]], he holds distant family members residing in [[Threshold]]. During his service, he submitted a report that intentionally omitted any mention of the location. Furthermore, Cirian views the actions taken by Ozriel as pure evil.}}
